t: A fully open family of chat models from Ai2 with public data and code.
steps: Find the Olmo Instruct models on the Ai2 site.
Ask IT to approve a runtime such as Ollama, llama.cpp, or LM Studio.
Install the runtime on a test computer.
Download a 7B Instruct model while online.
Check the computer has about 8 GB of memory or more, which is a general figure.
Go offline and test a short chat.
Check the model license on the model page before use.
